# Kautusang Bayan No. 09, Series of 1997

**Ordinance Regulating Slaughtering of Carabaos, Coconuts and Other Agricultural Products**

## Summary

This ordinance regulates the unauthorized selling of young coconuts (buko), mature coconuts (niyog), and copra (lukad) without the owner's consent in Pitogo, Quezon. It establishes penalties for violations, including fines and imprisonment, and aims to protect the rights of agricultural producers. The ordinance was enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of Pitogo, Quezon on March 31, [[1997]].

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1 - Paglabag:** It is prohibited to sell young coconuts (buko), mature coconuts (niyog), and copra (lukad) without the owner's permission.
2.  **Section 2 - Pagpapahintulot:** Only the owner or their authorized representative can sell these agricultural products.
3.  **Section 3 - Kaparusahan:** Violators will be fined not less than P2,500.00 or imprisoned for not less than six (6) months or both, at the discretion of the court, pursuant to [[Sec-447-RA7160|Section 447]] paragraph (a) item (2) subsection (ii) of the law.
4.  **Section 4 - Pagpapawalang Bisa:** Any ordinance inconsistent with this ordinance is repealed.
5.  **Section 5 - Pagkabisa:** This ordinance takes effect upon approval by the [[Sangguniang Panlalawigan]] of Quezon.
